what: Governed Real-Time Streams for Physiological Data
title: Governed Real-Time Streams for Physiological Data
text: PhysioStream provides loss-aware, deterministic foundations physiological data streams. package defines transport-neutral source sink contracts, bounded native SPSC buffer, -process loopback streams, governed snapshots PhysioExperiment. Optional Lab Streaming Layer (LSL) endpoints discover transport regular numeric signals irregular string markers without making Python liblsl mandatory package dependency. Governed XDF import preserves raw corrected timestamps, clock observations, stream XML, string markers multi-rate container. native XDF writer require Python. Recorded clock evidence can converted explicit, serializable model applied without interpolating samples: sign convention always master_time = device_time + offset(device_time). Reset segments fitted independently, synchronized timestamps appended beside original evidence rather replacing . Stateful DSP processors accept sample--channel chunks expose portable, hashed numeric state: Incremental PCA, online ICA, sliding STFT, optional independent PhysioPreprocess::StreamFilter instances use update/reset contract. Adaptive residuals ICA components mathematical estimates, claims clean physiological signals identified biological sources. Bounded pipelines schedule causal operations synchronously expose explicit loss latency evidence: measureLatency() reports monotonic ingest--emit p50/p95/p99 values recorded hardware. 50 ms target empirical reference budget, hard real-time operating-system guarantee. Stimulation-command outlets start closed disarmed, require explicit arm heartbeat state: MQTT uses configured reticulate environment containing pinned Paho publishes MQTT v5 commands retain = FALSE. QoS 1 may duplicate command, receivers must deduplicate exact command IDs. TTL serial/callback adapters generic integration boundaries, vendor stimulator protocols. Software maximum, dead-man, refractory gates defense depth : independently fail-safe stimulation hardware, limits, isolation, watchdog, emergency stop remain mandatory. broker, serial, adapter acknowledgement prove physical stimulation. LSL access uses existing reticulate Python environment containing pylsl. PhysioStream never installs selects environment: lslResolveStreams() returns validated StreamInfo objects. lslOutlet() lslInlet() create side-effect-free endpoints; assign result streamOpen() calling lslPush() lslPull(). Numeric inlet chunks enter bounded native ring can converted streamSnapshot(). Irregular string markers retrieved PhysioEvents lslMarkerEvents(). XDF reading uses existing environment policy pyxdf: rowData(stream)$xdf_time remains authoritative timestamp vector jittered irregular XDF streams; import operation resamples samples. PhysioStream research software infrastructure. provide real-time operating-system guarantees, network delivery guarantees, clock-accuracy guarantees, medical-device certification, independently sufficient stimulation safety.
code: model <- clockOffset(clock_times, clock_offsets) master_time <- driftCorrect(device_time, model) regular_time <- dejitter(master_time, nominal_srate = 1000) synced <- syncStreams(xdf_container) syncDiagnostics(synced) adaptive <- rlsFilter(n_taps = 16, forgetting = 0.995) filtered <- update(adaptive, signal_chunk, reference = noise_chunk) processorState(adaptive)  spectrum <- welchOnline(1000, window_samples = 512, hop_samples = 256) frame <- update(spectrum, signal_chunk) pipeline <- streamPipeline(   chunk_size = 32,   queue_capacity = 8,   backpressure = "error" ) operation <- bandpassRmsOp(sos, window_samples = 128) onChunk(pipeline, operation) pipelineEnqueue(pipeline, signal_chunk, timestamps) processed <- pipelineStep(pipeline) pipelineState(pipeline) trigger <- loopbackTrigger(   allowed_channels = c("left", "right"),   max_intensity = c(left = 20, right = 20),   intensity_unit = "mA",   max_duration_ms = 500,   refractory_ms = 1000,   deadman_ms = 2000 ) triggerOpen(trigger) armTrigger(trigger, session_id = "demo-session") receipt <- sendStim(   trigger, intensity = 5, channel = "left",   duration_ms = 100, command_id = "demo-command-1" ) triggerClose(trigger) lslAvailable(initialize = TRUE) lslBackendInfo() xdfAvailable(initialize = TRUE) xdfBackendInfo() x <- readXDF("recording.xdf") writeXDF(x, "roundtrip.xdf")
